# v5 retried attempts and their effect on each arm (post hoc)

**Post hoc.** Written on 2026-11-15, after all three campaigns' outcomes were known. Generated by `scripts/generate_v5_retry_sensitivity.py` from `artifacts/grounding-v5-d59-haiku-results/report.json`, `artifacts/grounding-v5-d59-haiku-network-retry/execution-plan.json`, `artifacts/grounding-v5-d59-replication-results/report.json`, `artifacts/grounding-v5-d59-replication/execution-plan.json`, `artifacts/grounding-v5-d59-action-extraction-results/report.json`, `artifacts/grounding-v5-d59-action-extraction-successor/execution-plan.json`. Structured source: `artifacts/grounding-v5-retry-sensitivity-v1.json`. Verify with `python -m scripts.verify_v5_retry_sensitivity`. This supplements, and does not replace, the frozen campaign reports.

## Retry rule in force

| Campaign | Transport retry rule | Attempts per action | Retry source |
|---|---|---:|---|
| historical | `claude-one-stopped-timeout-or-connection-retry-v1` | 2 | inferred; journal not retained, docs/evidence-index.md (2026-09-30, D5.9 private journals) |
| replication | `claude-one-stopped-timeout-connection-or-auth-retry-v1` | 2 | recorded |
| parser sensitivity | `claude-one-stopped-timeout-connection-or-auth-retry-v1` | 2 | recorded |

Inference rule: retries = model_attempts - environment_actions - (1 if the episode ended on invalid_output or infrastructure_failure else 0); checked against recorded retries trial by trial wherever they are recorded.

## Scope

Post hoc, written after all outcomes were known. Both columns are reported; neither replaces the frozen campaign results. Counting a retried episode as a failure is a pessimistic sensitivity, not a claim that the retry changed the outcome. No test is recomputed. The historical failure class is not recorded because its journal was not retained.
